title: Natural Transformation
author: Franziska Müller
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uvcew2w

steps.title: Induce tfoX expression
steps.instruction: Grow a strain containing tfoX regulated by an IPTG inducible promoter in 3 mL LBv2 medium with 100 ug/ml Carbenicillin.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 uM IPTG to the culture.
Incubate at 30 °C with shaking from 12:00 to 16:00 (4 hours).

steps.title: Perform natural transformation
steps.instruction: Prepare the transformation mixture and incubate statically.

substeps.instruction: Mix 3.5 µL of pre-culture with 350 µL of 28g/l XIO containing 100 uM IPTG.
Prepare a control sample without transformation DNA.
Incubate statically at 30 °C from 04:00 to 06:00 (2 hours).

steps.title: Recover cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of LBv2 to the reaction and incubate at 30 °C with shaking for 2 hours.

steps.title: Plate and incubate
steps.instruction: Plate the complete reaction onto LBv2 agar plates containing the antibiotic corresponding to the transformation DNA.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the plates at 37 °C for 12 hours.
